say:1:1631001001:1.text: Welcome! Everything you see here is forged with care and pride.
say:1:1631001001:1.source_cn: 欢迎光临，这里的每一样货物都是我们精心设计和锻造出来的。
say:1:1631001001:1.male: Welcome! Everything you see here is forged with care and pride.
say:1:1631001001:1.female: Welcome! Everything you see here is forged with care and pride.

say:2:1631001002:1.text: This humble shop has been in the family for three generations—Grandpa to Dad, now me and my sister Leila.
say:2:1631001002:1.source_cn: 这家“火与铁”锻造工坊是我祖父的产业，祖父传给了我父亲...
say:2:1631001002:1.male: This humble shop has been in the family for three generations—Grandpa to Dad, now me and my sister Leila.
say:2:1631001002:1.female: This humble shop has been in the family for three generations—Grandpa to Dad, now me and my sister Leila.

say:3:1631001003:1.text: I do the designing and selling, Leila does the hammering and clanging. As a fellow student here, I know exactly what people want. Trust me, my stuff flies off the shelves!
say:3:1631001003:1.source_cn: 我负责销售和设计，莉拉负责锻造。我也是莱希拉姆的学生，...
say:3:1631001003:1.male: I do the designing and selling, Leila does the hammering and clanging. As a fellow student here, I know exactly what people want. Trust me, my stuff flies off the shelves!
say:3:1631001003:1.female: I do the designing and selling, Leila does the hammering and clanging. As a fellow student here, I know exactly what people want. Trust me, my stuff flies off the shelves!

say:4:1631001004:1.text: And Leila? Don't let her size fool you—she trained under a dwarf master smith. Girl can forge anything thrown at her!
say:4:1631001004:1.source_cn: 而莉拉呢，别看她是个姑娘，但她从小就喜欢锻造，她的锻造...
say:4:1631001004:1.male: And Leila? Don't let her size fool you—she trained under a dwarf master smith. Girl can forge anything thrown at her!
say:4:1631001004:1.female: And Leila? Don't let her size fool you—she trained under a dwarf master smith. Girl can forge anything thrown at her!

say:5:1631001005:1.text: Anything forged here is guaranteed to last and shine. So go on, shop away with confidence!
say:5:1631001005:1.source_cn: “火与铁”出品，必属精品，请大家放心购买呦！
say:5:1631001005:1.male: Anything forged here is guaranteed to last and shine. So go on, shop away with confidence!
say:5:1631001005:1.female: Anything forged here is guaranteed to last and shine. So go on, shop away with confidence!
